fields.name: scripture
fields.label: Primary Scripture
fields.description: Reference and translation together, e.g. "Habakkuk 3:17-19 ESV"

fields.name: primaryTheme
fields.label: Primary Theme
fields.description: Short phrase describing the central theme, e.g. "Choosing joy when everything fails"

fields.name: audioUrl
fields.label: Audio URL
fields.description: Direct link to the MP3 file (R2 URL after upload).

fields.name: audioSizeBytes
fields.label: Audio File Size (bytes)
fields.description: Populated by upload-audio.mjs — required for podcast RSS enclosure tag.

fields.name: vimeoUrl
fields.label: Vimeo URL
fields.description: Vimeo player embed URL, e.g. "https://player.vimeo.com/video/123456"

fields.name: tagLine
fields.label: Tag Line
fields.description: 10–18 words. The punchy hook used on listing pages and social cards.

fields.name: shortDescription
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: 40–60 words. Used for search results, social previews, and listing cards.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: One sentence shown below the scripture reference on the sermon page.

fields.name: hook
fields.label: Hook
fields.description: "What this is about" — a paragraph-length question or tension that frames the sermon for a visitor.

fields.name: takeaways
fields.label: What You'll Take Away
fields.description: Bullet list of concrete things listeners will learn or be equipped to do.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: This Is For You If…
fields.description: Bullet list of situations or feelings that describe the target listener.

fields.name: bigIdea
fields.label: The Big Idea
fields.description: One sentence capturing the sermon's single central claim.

fields.name: keyScriptureRef
fields.label: Key Scripture Reference
fields.description: e.g. "Habakkuk 3:17-19 ESV"

fields.name: keyScriptureText
fields.label: Key Scripture Text
fields.description: The full quoted text of the key scripture passage.

fields.name: keyIllustration
fields.label: Key Illustration
fields.description: The main illustration or analogy from the sermon, summarised in a paragraph.

fields.name: application
fields.label: What This Means for Us
fields.description: Practical take-home action points.

fields.name: toRemember
fields.label: To Remember
fields.description: A single memorable closing statement.

fields.name: categories
fields.label: Categories
fields.description: Broad thematic categories for filtering and navigation.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Thematic tags only — series, book, and scripture refs are captured in dedicated fields above.

fields.name: guid
fields.label: Podcast GUID
fields.description: Squarespace permalink preserved as the podcast episode GUID. Leave blank for new sermons — the page URL will be used.

fields.name: review
fields.label: Needs Review
fields.description: Flag this sermon for editorial review before it goes live.

fields.name: transcribedBy
fields.label: Transcribed By
fields.description: The service that generated the transcript, e.g. "deepgram-nova-2".

fields.name: wordCount
fields.label: Word Count
fields.description: Auto-populated by the import script — do not edit manually.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Sermon Image URL
fields.description: Populated by script2 from the calendar event.

fields.name: sermonUrl
fields.label: Sermon URL
fields.description: Link back to the full sermon page.

fields.name: ref
fields.label: Reference
fields.description: e.g. "Luke 5:8"

fields.name: reflection
fields.label: Reflection
fields.description: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

fields.name: lifeApplication
fields.label: Life Application
fields.description: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Short statement always visible in the collapsed accordion.

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Full Statement
fields.description: The numbered clauses shown when the article is expanded.

fields.name: scriptures
fields.label: Scripture References
fields.description: One group of references per numbered line.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Cover image shown on the listing page and at the top of the guide.

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Excerpt
fields.description: Short summary shown on the guides listing page.

fields.name: embedUrl
fields.label: Embed URL
fields.description: The src URL from the Vimeo iframe embed code (e.g. https://vimeo.com/event/255155/embed).

fields.name: streamUrl
fields.label: Stream URL
fields.description: Direct audio stream URL (used as the HTML5 audio src and as a fallback link).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Service time and data-usage info shown below the player.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Course Title
fields.description: e.g. "Truth and Grace". The filename/slug is derived automatically.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown on the course index page.

fields.name: requiredListId
fields.label: Required PCO List ID
fields.description: Planning Center list ID — only members of this list can access the course. Leave blank for public access.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Slug
fields.description: URL-safe ID matching the folder name, e.g. "the-son-of-god". Must be lowercase with hyphens.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Display name, e.g. "The Son of God".

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End Date & Time
fields.description: Optional — leave blank for single-time events.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: e.g. "Main Hall" or "Online via Zoom"

fields.name: description
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: Shown on listing cards and social previews (1–2 sentences).

fields.name: registrationUrl
fields.label: Registration / Info Link
fields.description: Optional external link for sign-ups or more information.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short excerpt shown on listing cards and social previews.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Site Identity & SEO
fields.description: Site-wide identity. These values appear on every page — the Site Name is shown in the header navigation and used as the default browser title; the Description is the default for search results and social shares.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Shown in the header navigation on every page. Lives in Global Config because it's the same site-wide — each page sets its own browser title via the Meta Title field on the page, and this Site Name is used as the fallback if a page is ever missing one.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Default description shown in search results and social-sharing previews when a page does not provide its own.

fields.name: siteOwner
fields.label: Site Owner (shown in footer)
fields.description: Your name or company name. Displayed in the site footer.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown next to the Site Name in the header navigation.

fields.name: whatsappPhone
fields.label: WhatsApp Phone Number
fields.description: Used for the WhatsApp chat button. Include country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 27821234567).

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation Menu
fields.description: Links shown in the header navigation. Reorder, add, or remove items below. The Site Name shown to the left of these links is set in Site Identity & SEO above.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Link Label
fields.description: The text shown in the nav for this link.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Where this nav item points (e.g. /about or https://example.com). Leave empty if this item only opens a submenu.

fields.name: children
fields.label: Submenu Items
fields.description: Optional. Add items here to create a dropdown under this nav link.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Any Tabler icon name, e.g. tabler:brand-x, tabler:book-2, tabler:brand-github. Browse at https://icones.js.org/collection/tabler

fields.name: banner
fields.label: Announcement Banner
fields.description: A thin strip shown at the very top of every page. Toggle it on/off without losing the text.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Optional. The banner text becomes a clickable link.

fields.name: auth
fields.label: Member Access
fields.description: Messages shown on the sign-in and access pages, and in the magic-link email sent to members.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Text
fields.description: First line of the email body, before the sign-in link.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer Note
fields.description: Small note shown below the form.

fields.name: kidsChurch
fields.label: Kids Church Ministry
fields.description: Names and age ranges shown on the Kids Church landing page and lesson headers.

fields.name: ministryName
fields.label: Ministry Name
fields.description: e.g. "Bravehearts" or "Kids Church" — shown as the main heading.

fields.name: preschoolLabel

fields.name: preschoolAges
fields.label: Pre-School Age Range
fields.description: e.g. "Ages 3–5"

fields.name: juniorLabel
fields.label: Junior Group Name
fields.description: e.g. "Explorers" or "Junior"

fields.name: juniorAges
fields.label: Junior Age Range
fields.description: e.g. "Ages 6–9"

fields.name: seniorLabel
fields.label: Senior Group Name
fields.description: e.g. "Champions" or "Senior"

fields.name: seniorAges
fields.label: Senior Age Range
fields.description: e.g. "Ages 10–12"
